title: Police overtime: nine limits exceeded, cards self-approved, one investigation

beats.text: Nine overtime limits. The Police Department broke every one of them, year after year.

visual.label: overtime limits tested

beats.text: So what did police overtime cost in fiscal 2023?

beats.text: The second finding: the checks. Unscheduled overtime is approved verbally, and the signed card is the record.

beats.text: Of 559 cards sampled, 18 showed a lieutenant or sergeant approving their own overtime.

beats.text: The third finding. 10B overtime is work that outside bodies pay for.

visual.label: 10B overtime
visual.sub: work outside bodies pay for; outside the overtime cap

beats.text: The officers’ agreement bars heavy sick-leave users from it.

visual.label: 10B overtime
visual.sub: work outside bodies pay for; outside the overtime cap

beats.text: Yet the audit counts 51,206 ineligible hours,

visual.sub: January 2021 to June 2023

beats.text: A 2021 review found more than 400 ineligible. The rule was not enforced.

visual.text: The review found more than 400 employees ineligible to work 10B assignments; the provision was not enforced

beats.text: The 2026 agreement then raised the test from 20 to 40 hours of sick leave in three months.
The fourth finding: General Fund overtime ran 54.8 million dollars over its original budget.

visual.label: General Fund overtime above its original budget
visual.sub: fiscal 2022-23

beats.text: The Controller’s budget file shows overtime over budget every year from 2019 to 2026.
In all, it paid 2.12 times its budget, the highest ratio of 12 departments.
In March 2023 the Department needed 25.4 million from the City’s General Reserve.

visual.label: General Reserve
visual.sub: a transfer to pay for overtime, March 2023

beats.text: Special initiatives took 319,945 overtime hours,

beats.text: A complaint that an employee offered coworkers money to call in sick was closed for insufficient evidence.
The audit stops in June 2023.
Payroll police overtime reached 163.4 million dollars in fiscal 2026.
The Department told the Board about 85 percent is done or well under way, without saying which.

visual.kicker: Police Department to the Board, 30 April 2025
